On Your Turn
Each turn you can Move, take one Action, maybe one Bonus Action, and between turns one Reaction.
Actions
  • Attack with a weapon or damaging cantrip (see Skills page)
  • Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Hide, Help, Search, Ready, Shove, Grapple, Influence, Study, Utilize

  • None special
Reactions
  • Opportunity Attack when a creature leaves your reach
  • Cast a spell with a Reaction casting time
House Rules
  • Catch your breath. Out of combat, spend one Hit Die + your Constitution modifier to heal. Up to 3 times all run; mark each on the Hit Dice track above.
  • Spellcasting. Cast any spell of a type you can cast from a found Spell Book, if you have the slots. You can reach one level above your normal maximum by spending two slots of the level just below it: two level-1 slots cast a level-2 spell, two level-2 slots cast a level-3 spell like Fireball. That over-level cast needs a spellcasting check (DC 10 + the spell's level). The slots are spent whether you pass or fail, and a failure fizzles the spell.

Who You Are

Your Ancestry: Orc

Your ancestry gives you a few natural traits.

Adrenaline Rush. You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Darkvision. You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.
Relentless Endurance. When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this trait, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest.
Your Background: Sailor

You lived as a seafarer, wind at your back and decks swaying beneath your feet. You’ve perched on barstools in more ports of call than you can remember, faced mighty storms, and swapped stories with folk who live beneath the waves.

Trained Skills. Acrobatics and Perception (already on your Skills page).
Tools. Navigator's Tools.
Origin Feat. Tavern Brawler (explained under Your Feats).
Your Feats

Feats are special perks from your background and choices, on top of your class.

Weapon Mastery. Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of Simple or Martial Melee weapons of your choice, such as Greataxes and Handaxes. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice weapon drills and change one of those weapon choices.
Tavern Brawler. Origin Feat. You gain the following benefits. Enhanced Unarmed Strike. When you hit with your Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to 1d4 plus your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage of an Unarmed Strike. Damage Rerolls.
Dark Bargain. A pact perk from your backstory. Confirm its exact effect with your DM before play.
Your Class: Barbarian (Path of the Berserker)

A Fierce Warrior of Primal Rage. Barbarians are mighty warriors who are powered by primal forces of the multiverse that manifest as a Rage. Primary Ability: Strength. Hit Point Die: D12. Saves: Strength & Constitution

Channel Rage into Violent Fury. Barbarians who walk the Path of the Berserker direct their Rage primarily toward violence. Their path is one of untrammeled fury, and they thrill in the chaos of battle as they allow their Rage to seize and empower them.

Who You Are

Track your limited uses here. Each box is one use, and every per-rest use is doubled because this dungeon has no rest.
Relentless Endurance
When dropped to 0 HP but not killed outright, drop to 1 HP instead. One use.
Rage
Bonus Action to Rage: resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing, plus bonus melee damage.
Rage. Bonus Action (Rage use). If you aren't wearing Heavy armor, enter a Rage as a Bonus Action. For up to 10 minutes you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, deal +2 damage on Strength-based melee hits, and have Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. It ends early if you put on Heavy armor, or if you end a turn without having attacked a foe or taken damage since your last turn. Track uses on your usage boxes above.
Reckless Attack. Free. On your first attack of the turn, you can attack recklessly: you gain Advantage on your Strength-based melee attack rolls this turn, but attack rolls against you have Advantage until your next turn.
Unarmored Defense. Passive. While you wear no armor, your AC is 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier. You can still use a Shield.
Danger Sense. Passive. You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws, unless something stops you from moving or acting.
Primal Knowledge. Free (while raging). While your Rage is active, you can make Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival checks using Strength instead of their usual ability.
Weapon Mastery. Passive. You can use the mastery property (such as Cleave or Topple) of two kinds of Melee weapons you chose.
Frenzy. Free (while raging). If you use Reckless Attack while your Rage is active, the first creature you hit with a Strength-based attack on your turn takes extra damage: roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus (2 at your level).
